name: zelta-calorie-target
description: Estimates maintenance calories with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula and an activity level, then a daily calorie target for a chosen weekly weight-loss pace with safety rails: never below 1,200 kcal for women or 1,500 kcal for men, and no faster than 1% of body weight a week. Also estimates how many weeks a weight goal takes at a daily calorie deficit. Estimates only, not medical advice.
